fact: The Sudanese Center for Policy Studies says mobile banking data transits infrastructure Sudan neither owns nor regulates, with no statutory requirement governing data localization or cross-border transfer; it only proposes localisation as a first legislative tranche.

Global Voices states Sudan has no law imposing data localization; it reports a former senior Central Bank official saying the Bank and other government bodies work under an undeclared localization policy, while DNS lookups showed several government websites hosted abroad. Dated to the article's published date.

Sudan's Minister of Communications and Digital Transformation says the alternative national data centre project is meant to restore sovereign national infrastructure and secure and protect all government data.
